recipes.title: Bangalore Gujarati Handvo
mainIngredients: One of the reasons the Gujarati Handvo Recipe has survived for centuries is that every ingredient serves a purpose.
Rice provides structure and creates the characteristic crisp outer layer.
Toor dal adds body and earthy flavour.
Urad dal improves fermentation and creates softness.
Moong dal helps balance the texture while improving digestibility.
Traditional Gujarati households prefer bottle gourd because it keeps the Handvo moist and soft without making it heavy.
Sesame seeds are essential for the authentic flavour of Gujarati Handvo. They create the signature nutty aroma and crispy crust.

recipes.title: Family Gujarati Handvo
mainIngredients: One of the reasons the Gujarati Handvo Recipe has survived for centuries is that every ingredient serves a purpose.
Rice provides structure and creates the characteristic crisp outer layer.
Toor dal adds body and earthy flavour.
Urad dal improves fermentation and creates softness.
Moong dal helps balance the texture while improving digestibility.
Traditional Gujarati households prefer bottle gourd because it keeps the Handvo moist and soft without making it heavy.
Sesame seeds are essential for the authentic flavour of Gujarati Handvo. They create the signature nutty aroma and crispy crust.

recipes.title: Grand Dal Tadka
mainIngredients: Toor Dal: This is the foundational lentil
giving the dal its structure and classic flavor.
Masoor Dal: These lentils cook quickly and dissolve
creating a creamy consistency without needing any cream.
Water: For pressure cooking the lentils. You may need more later to adjust the consistency.
Turmeric : For its earthy flavor and beautiful golden color.
Ghee: The absolute star of the tadka. Its nutty
rich flavor is unparalleled. For a vegan version
you can use a neutral oil like avocado or coconut oil.
Mustard Seeds: They pop when hot and add a slightly pungent
broken in half: These infuse the ghee with a smoky
savory spice that aids digestion and mimics the flavor of onions and garlic. A little goes a long way.
The other half of the finely chopped Onion: Sautéing this in the tadka adds a layer of sweet
Red Chili : Adds color and a final kick of heat. Be careful not to burn it.
Lemon Juice: Brightens up the entire dish and cuts through the richness.
A small dollop of Ghee: For an extra touch of richness when serving.

A little goes a long way., The other half of the finely chopped Onion: Sautéing this in the tadka adds a layer of sweet, caramelized flavor., Red Chili : Adds color and a final kick of heat. Be careful not to burn it., Fresh Cilantro, Lemon Juice: Brightens up the entire dish and cuts through the richness., A small dollop of Ghee: For an extra touch of richness when serving.
